subject: Aperture program reprioritization — demo slot release
messages:
From: Elena Martinez <elena@aperturehealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Reprioritizing our AI initiatives — demo slot release

Hi Naomi / team,

Quick update from our side — after our leadership sync yesterday we need to deprioritize the LLM/inference work that we discussed. We are shifting headcount and Q2 roadmap to focus on core ETL, regulatory reporting, and a separate analytics platform migration. Practically that means we will not proceed with the pilot this quarter and would like to release the demo slot we had scheduled for the week of Apr 12.

Two asks:
- Please remove the demo from your calendar and release any reserved capacity for that week.
- Keep any consolidated notes and the initial demo agenda; we may revisit in Q3 depending on how the migration goes.

We want to avoid heavy procurement overhead or paperwork until we are ready. If there is a simple way to keep the initial PO/quote on file without committing spend, that would be helpful. Otherwise, please treat this as a hold/reprioritize request rather than a full cancellation.

Thanks — and apologies for the churn. Travel and team availability (several folks are on site for regulatory audits) were a big factor.

Elena Martinez
Head of Data Platform
Aperture Health

Attachments: aperture_q2_roadmap.pdf (application/pdf), procurement-timeline.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Martinez <elena@aperturehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Reprioritizing our AI initiatives — demo slot release

Elena — thanks for the clear note and for flagging the audit/travel constraints. Totally understand the shift.

We will:
- Remove the demo slot for Apr 12 and release the reserved capacity.
- Archive the draft demo agenda and your roadmap PDF so we can pick up quickly if you reopen.
- Add Aperture to our Q3 re-engagement list and put a tentative check-in for early July (no commitments).

Two quick operational proposals so we don't create extra work for your procurement team:
1) We can issue a non-binding quote and keep it on file; it will not auto-activate.
2) If you'd prefer, we can hold a 30-minute catch-up in July rather than preserving any procurement paperwork.

Which option feels lighter on your side? Happy to do whichever avoids extra paperwork during audit season.

If helpful, I can also offer a $1,000 platform credit to be applied to a future pilot as a courtesy for the schedule churn — no strings attached. Let me know and I will coordinate internally.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
naomi@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0198

From: Samir Rao <samir@aperturehealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwoodinference.com>, Elena Martinez <elena@aperturehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Reprioritizing our AI initiatives — demo slot release

Naomi — thanks for the quick response. Confirming Aperture is releasing the slot and we prefer the "no paperwork" option for now.

One small ask: when you archive the agenda, could you also attach the short SSO/SCIM requirements doc so our security lead can review asynchronously? No rush — we just want to reduce friction if/when we pick this back up.

Samir Rao
Director, Platform Security
Aperture Health

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Reprioritizing our AI initiatives — demo slot release (Aperture)

Karthik / Jordan — forwarding final confirmation from Aperture. Thread below for context. Action items:

- Jordan: please remove the Apr 12 demo from the schedule and release the reserved capacity. Mark the slot as available in the shared calendar and update resource reservations.
- Jordan: upload the current demo agenda (demo-agenda-apt.v1.docx) and SSO requirements to the Aperture folder in Drive; flag them for quick retrieval if re-engaged.
- Karthik: please set the deal status in HubSpot to "Deprioritized — hold" (deal id AP-H-2027-042) and add a Q3 re-engagement task for the week of Jul 5 with a 30-minute placeholder.
- Karthik: please authorize the courtesy $1,000 credit Naomi offered (apply as a future-use platform credit) so we have it available if Aperture returns. Let me know if you want any justification text for finance.

Also: no more paperwork for now per their ask. I suggested the non-binding quote option but Aperture prefers minimal overhead.

Thanks — short and tidy. Quoting the prospect below.

—Naomi
